channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Mercado segue apostando em Flávio mesmo com incômodo por promessas de campanha
item.description: The financial market remains optimistic about Flávio Bolsonaro's election as president, despite criticism of his campaign promises. Asset managers believe his government would be preferable to Lula's reelection.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recusa sabatina no SBT e vai a ato com apoiadores
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, declined an interview on SBT, citing scheduling conflicts. Instead, he attended a rally with supporters the same day. His decision sparked reactions regarding candidates' engagement with the press during the election campaign.

item.title: Camilo: Há tentativa clara da Meta de impedir avanço da campanha de Lula
item.description: Senator Camilo Santana, campaign coordinator for Lula, accused Meta of trying to block the president's campaign progress on digital platforms. He highlighted actions by the company's social networks, including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, as obstacles to Lula's communication reach. The statement was made on November 21st.

item.title: 'Quem é Mariana': entenda busca relacionada a Flávio impulsionada por Janones
item.description: A post by André Janones and the hashtag #QuemEMarianaFlavio drove searches linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the 'rachadinha' scheme at Alerj, which was closed by the Public Ministry. The strategy aims to associate the lawmaker with alleged public fund embezzlement.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que conversa com Globo para fact-checking em tempo real no debate de sexta
item.description: Lula's campaign is negotiating with TV Globo to include real-time fact-checking during Friday's presidential debate. The head of the presidential office's communication secretariat, Sidônio Palmeira, confirmed the broadcaster's willingness to use the tool during the live broadcast.

item.title: Defensoria pede ao STF ação urgente contra prefeitos que não garantem transporte gratuito no dia da eleição
item.description: The Brazilian Federal Public Defender's Office requested an urgent decision from the Supreme Federal Court to ensure free transportation to voters in the runoff elections. The agency claims that mayors who fail to guarantee this right may face penalties.

item.title: “Faria Limers” marcam “happy hour da vitória” em churrascaria após eleição
item.description: Investor groups are organizing a pre-victory celebration at a steakhouse for candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), anticipating his win in the 2026 election. The event runs parallel to financial market growth and electoral polarization.

item.title: Previsão inicial de renegociação no Desenrola 3.0 é de R$ 90 bilhões
item.description: The Brazilian Minister of Finance, Dario Durigan, announced that from October 21st, financial institutions can express interest in the debt auction scheduled under the Desenrola 3.0 program, with an initial estimate of R$ 90 billion in debts to be renegotiated. Despite the high amount, the maximum impact will be R$ 9 billion due to the minimum 90% discount stipulated in the Provisional Measure. The auction, expected for mid-November, will proceed regardless of the October 25th election results.

item.title: Luciano Huck chama denúncia de interferência nas eleições de "fake news"
item.description: Luciano Huck dismissed allegations of election interference by Donald Trump as 'fake news' and shared a statement from RenovaBR denying receipt of foreign funds. The TV host emphasized that the institute's executive director participated in a U.S. State Department exchange program but clarified the organization is nonpartisan and not linked to foreign governments. The controversy involves alleged attempts to influence the Brazilian electoral scenario.

item.title: No DF, Flávio tem 50% contra 39% de Lula, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on October 21, 2026, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 50% of voting intentions in the Federal District, against 39% for Lula (PT) in the projected second round. Government approval for Lula in the DF stands at 41%, with 53% disapproving.

item.title: Coordenador de Lula diz que petista aceita condições de Flávio para abrir sigilos
item.description: Lula's campaign coordinator Camilo Santana said the PT accepts Flávio Bolsonaro's conditions to break secrecy, calling them a maneuver. The statement suggests possible progress in parliamentary cooperation.

item.title: Lula aceita exigências de Flávio e Marcola aceita abrir sigilo
item.description: Lula agrees to open financial and phone records conditionally, demanding that Flávio Bolsonaro release data on Marcola, the Lula Institute, and Alcazar Holdings. The PT campaign seeks reciprocity at the TSE ahead of the runoff.

item.title: Lula aceita condições de Flávio para ampliar quebra de sigilo, diz campanha
item.description: Lula's campaign authorizes the release of 20-year bank, tax, and phone secrecy records, conditioning this to reciprocal transparency demands on Flávio Bolsonaro. Political coordinator Camilo Santana stated that the president opposes none of the senator's requests, provided Flávio complies with the same. The scope includes data from companies owned by Lula's children and former chief of staff Marcola.

item.title: TSE: informação de que 4 mil seções mudaram de lugar estava incorreta
item.description: The TSE corrected a previous claim that 4,352 polling stations had changed location between election rounds, clarifying that the actual number is 343 stations. Authorities attributed the error to an incorrect comparison with 2024 data and failures by regional courts in updating the system. The electoral court urged voters to confirm their voting location through official channels.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que aceita abrir sigilo de Marcola caso Flávio Bolsonaro abra o seu
item.description: Lula's campaign agreed to unveil Marcola's records if Flávio Bolsonaro releases his own, as stated by former minister Camilo Santana.

item.title: Governo pode gastar até R$ 9 bilhões em leilão de dívidas
item.description: The federal government, through Minister of Finance Dario Durigan, announced it may spend up to R$9 billion to purchase debts from individuals and small entrepreneurs under the Desenrola 3.0 program, with minimum discounts of 90%. The initiative aims to renegotiate debts overdue by 2 to 4.5 years, prioritizing low-income debtors.

item.title: Nikolas versus Janones
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira and André Janones lead the digital strategies of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula respectively, with Nikolas focusing on Instagram and Janones on WhatsApp. Both are considered key players for digital mobilization in the 2026 elections.

item.title: PSB e PDT oficializam apoio à reeleição de Hugo Motta
item.description: The PSB and PDT officially endorsed Hugo Motta's (Republicanos) re-election as Speaker of the Chamber of Deputies, expanding support to 12 parties and further isolating the PL ahead of the February vote.

item.title: Quaest: Aumento dos indecisos em pesquisa espontânea indica voto menos convicto em meio à pancadaria
item.description: The doubling of undecided voters in the spontaneous survey reflects less committed voting amid a polarized second round between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The campaign, marked by controversies and tense debates, makes election outcomes hard to predict.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que aceita condições de Flávio sobre abertura de sigilo
item.description: Lula's campaign team announced acceptance of 19 conditions proposed by Flávio Bolsonaro for the release of banking and phone records. Camilo Santana stated that a formal document will be filed at the TSE, covering companies linked to the president's family and the Lula Institute.

item.title: Proposta de Mendonça não vai adiante no TSE e canais do WhatsApp funcionarão no 2º turno
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, decided not to move forward with Minister André Mendonça's proposal to restrict WhatsApp channels with over 200,000 users during the election period. The decision maintains current rules, particularly affecting the 'Exército de Lula' channel led by André Janones. The measure faced criticism from media, social networks, and part of Lula's campaign.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Gerp sobre a disputa entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula a quatro dias do segundo turno
item.description: In the latest Gerp poll, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 53% of valid votes against Lula's 47%, within a two-point margin of error. The race remains tight, with 97% of voters reporting a decided choice. Voting takes place on Sunday, 25.

item.title: Ala do TSE acredita que big techs interferiram nas campanhas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Some TSE ministers believe big techs, particularly Meta, influenced campaign reach for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, reducing some candidates' visibility while boosting others. The TSE unanimously banned Meta from restricting content about candidates, but neither campaign was satisfied with the company's explanations. Allegations include algorithm manipulation and spread of false content, keeping dissatisfaction with big techs as a unified concern during the election.

item.title: PSB e PDT também declaram apoio à reeleição de Motta e se juntam à bloco majoritário da Câmara
item.description: PSB and PDT declared support for Hugo Motta's re-election as president of the Chamber of Deputies, strengthening his bloc with 12 parties and 273 seats. With 257 votes required for election, Motta has conditions to remain in office, though the secret vote raises uncertainties about deputy loyalty. The support is justified based on legislative agenda and institutional stability.

item.title: Após mudança do TSE, brasileira residente em Londres teria de viajar 600 km para votar
item.description: TSE change forces Brazilian voter in London to travel 600 km to vote. Gabriela Ferreira had her polling station moved from London to Edinburgh, preventing her participation. Federal representative Sônia Guajajara demands urgent action from the Electoral Court.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro impõe condições para liberar sigilos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro authorizes the disclosure of his banking, tax, and phone records from the past 20 years but demands that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expand the scope of data release, including figures close to him such as former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro and his brother Frei Chico. The condition was sent to the TSE as a response to the authorization granted by Lula to Minister André Mendonça. For the PL candidate, Lula's request constitutes a 'true legal aberration'.

item.title: Dólar sobe 0,17% e fecha a R$ 5,027; Ibovespa cai
item.description: The Brazilian real depreciated as the dollar rose 0,17% to R$5,027, while the Ibovespa stock index fell 0,86%, reacting to a Quaest poll showing a tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in the 2026 presidential runoff. The survey, with a 2-point margin of error, indicates 45% for Flávio and 44% for Lula when including blank and null votes.

item.title: Campanha diz que Lula não se opõe a condições de Flávio Bolsonaro para quebra de sigilo
item.description: Lula's campaign stated the president does not oppose Flávio Bolsonaro's conditions for lifting confidentiality, calling them a 'maneuver'. Flávio demanded transparency on family companies, aides, the Master case, and corporate card expenses, while Lula will file a response at the TSE.

item.title: Ibovespa desvaloriza com crescimento numérico de Lula em nova pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: The Ibovespa dropped 0.86% to 206,400 points, pressured by the latest Quaest poll showing a technical tie between Lula (44%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (45%). Investors adopt a cautious stance toward re-election scenarios, favoring safer assets like fixed income. Among banking stocks, most declined except for Itaú.

item.title: 'Desafio dos sigilos': veja as diferenças das manifestações de Lula e Flávio sobre divulgação de dados
item.description: Lula proposed opening personal and family records from the last 8 years, conditioning release on reciprocal action from Flávio Bolsonaro, escalating the transparency debate in the election race. Flávio countered with a demand that Lula disclose corporate and family data too, keeping the clash symbolic and inconclusive.

item.title: PSB e PDT fecham apoio a Motta, e presidente da Câmara reúne 12 partidos para buscar recondução, dificultando articulação do PL
item.description: PSB and PDT support the re-election of Hugo Motta as Chamber president, gathering 12 parties and isolating the PL in the race. The PT is also expected to align with the candidacy, expanding support for Motta, who has moved closer to Lula during the electoral campaign. With 266 deputies, Motta has enough strength for the election, but the secret vote maintains uncertainties.

item.title: TSE vai investigar promessa de ‘prêmio’ em emendas para cidades que votarem em Flávio
item.description: The chief electoral officer accepted an investigation into promises of parliamentary amendments to cities voting for Flávio Bolsonaro, filed by Lula's campaign against PL and PP candidates. Reinaldo Azambuja's statement about 'rewarding' cities with higher votes was deemed indicative of abuse of power.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio participa de comício em Fortaleza
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attended the 'Bloco do 22' rally in Fortaleza (CE) on Wednesday (Oct 21, 2026), four days before the presidential runoff. Recent polls show Bolsonaro leading nationally in 15 of 16 surveys, while Lula (PT) leads in only one. The runoff is scheduled for October 25.

item.title: Alckmin e ex-ministro de Bolsonaro reforçam apelo de Lula na TV a eleitores de direita
item.description: Lula leverages TV advertising to court right-wing voters, supported by Alckmin and General Santos Cruz, a former Bolsonaro minister, who attacks Flávio Bolsonaro's father. The campaign underscores internal rifts in the PL, criticizing personal 'cowardice' and 'unpreparedness' linked to the prior administration.

item.title: PSB e PDT manifestam apoio à reeleição de Motta à presidência da Câmara
item.description: The Brazilian Socialist Party (PSB) and the Democratic Party of the Republic (PDT) expressed support for the re-election of Hugo Motta (Republicans-PB) as President of the Chamber of Deputies, reacting to the possibility of the Liberal Party (PL) taking control of the legislature from 2027. This decision reflects partisan alignment and political strategy regarding the competition for the chamber's leadership.

item.title: Aliado de Flávio Bolsonaro investigado pela PF pagou viagens de Cláudio Castro para o exterior
item.description: Federal Police is investigating Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, for funding international trips of Cláudio Castro. The case also involves a million-dollar contract between companies linked to Tomaz and Castro's administration in Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Comitê da ONU pede explicações à Meta sobre atuação eleitoral no Brasil
item.description: The UN Human Rights Council has requested Meta to provide explanations regarding its role in the Brazilian electoral process, citing potential restrictions on freedom of expression and unequal treatment of campaigns. The document mentions temporary suspension of accounts, disparities in engagement, and algorithmic impacts that may influence elections.

item.title: Quaest no DF, 2º turno: Flávio Bolsonaro, 50%; Lula, 39%
item.description: A Quaest survey released on October 21 shows that in the Federal District, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 50% and Lula (PT) with 39% in the second round of the presidential election. With a 3-point margin of error, 94% of surveyed voters have already decided, while 5% may still change their vote. Lula's government approval in the DF is at 41%, with 53% disapproval.

item.title: Preso, Silvinei Vasques envia lista de nomes para chefiar PRF em caso de vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Silvinei Vasques, arrested since December, sent the Bolsonaro family a list of names to lead the Federal Highway Police (PRF) if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 election. The subscriber-exclusive article highlights this political move amid strategic positioning for public security.

item.title: Congresso resiste a usar verba de emendas para financiar promessa de Lula de garantir transporte de graça no fim de semana
item.description: Congressional leaders resist the proposal to use parliamentary amendments to fund free public transport on weekends, presented by President Lula's government. Lawmakers fear losing amendment funds, which serve as political currency, and will await election results before deciding. The measure may advance if Lula wins, but faces opposition if Flávio Bolsonaro is elected.

item.title: ONU aponta falta de isenção da Meta em eleição brasileira
item.description: UN and NetLab experts point to restrictions on free speech and uneven content treatment on Meta platforms during Brazil's 2026 elections, mainly affecting Lula da Silva's campaign. Meta denies any political bias, attributing issues to technical incidents due to its large-scale operations.

item.title: Camilo propõe ‘Lei Ana Clara’ para impedir parlamentar de atuar como advogado em crimes contra vida
item.description: The PT leader in the Senate, Camilo Santana, proposed the 'Ana Clara Law' to ban legislators from acting as lawyers in crimes against life. The initiative follows controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro, accused of defending a military police officer who killed a child. The proposal aims to prevent conflicts of interest between political and judicial activities.

item.title: Juristas criticam minuta do TSE sobre canais de WhatsApp e alertam para mudança nas regras às vésperas da eleição
item.description: Lawyers criticize the TSE's proposal to restrict political content on WhatsApp channels before the second round, claiming it is undemocratic and violates freedom of expression. If approved, the measure would ban disclosures in channels with over 200,000 followers between 48 hours before and 24 hours after the election. The TSE president said the review will be postponed to the 2028 elections.

item.title: No segundo turno, o Brasil dança à beira do abismo
item.description: The article examines the rise of far-right forces in the 2026 Brazilian elections, highlighting the risk to democratic institutions. It compares the current scenario with the rise of fascism and Nazism, warning about the threat to checks on elected leaders' power and opposition freedoms.

item.title: Flávio diz ao TSE aceitar abrir sigilo de 20 anos, mas cria lista de condições de divulgação de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro authorized the disclosure of his bank, tax, and phone records for the past 20 years, but made it conditional on the release of information about Lula's inner circle, including meetings with Daniel Vorcaro and public spending records. The petition to the TSE also requests transparency on government expenses and documents related to fraud investigations in the INSS.

item.title: Lula cancela entrevista para poupar a voz antes de debate da Globo
item.description: President Lula canceled an interview to preserve his voice ahead of the Globo debate, due to hoarseness linked to his history of laryngeal cancer. His campaign team is focusing on conserving his voice in the coming days, viewing the debate as the most important event of the election's final stretch.

item.title: Mendonça nega pedido de Flávio para retirar postagens que o chamam de 'mentiroso master' e 'bajulador de Trump'
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's requests to remove Lula's posts calling him a 'master liar' and 'Trump flatterer', stating that electoral justice should not censor political debate. Mendonça deemed the statements as rhetorical hyperbole and reaffirmed freedom of expression between candidates.

item.title: Os eleitos/José Medeiros: Áudio do ‘eleitor que bebe detergente’ foi tirado de contexto
item.description: Senator-elect José Medeiros (PL) told the Estadão that an audio clip where he remarks his voter 'prays to aliens and drinks detergent' was taken out of context and edited, originally being a personal explanation to mayor Chico Mendes. Medeiros criticized traditional politics for not understanding the 2013 movement and defended that Brazilian voters maintain the same demands decades later.

item.title: Órgão da ONU diz que atuação da Meta pode comprometer eleição brasileira e pede reparações
item.description: UN special rapporteurs warn that Meta's activities could undermine the integrity of Brazil's 2026 electoral process, calling for measures to ensure transparency and fundamental rights. The alert strengthens international monitoring regarding potential undue influence on the elections.

item.title: Moraes manda prender réu do 8/1 que atuou como 'fiscal do PL' na Argentina
item.description: Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the preventive arrest of 52-year-old Claudiomiro da Rosa Soares, charged in connection with the January 8 riots and accused of acting as a PL party monitor in Argentina during elections. The arrest aims to reinforce legal security and deter further violence against democratic institutions.
